chunks: He (peace be upon him) was asked: Which of the two is better; justice or generosity? He (peace be upon him) replied:

key_terms.الْعَدْلُ: Justice; fairness in distribution and judgment

ai.seo_question: Which is more virtuous: justice or generosity according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) is asked to compare the merits of justice (al-'adl) and generosity (al-jud). This hadith highlights the fundamental virtue of justice as a primary quality of leadership and divine attribute, often placing it above even the virtuous trait of generosity. In Shia scholarly tradition, this distinction underscores that while generosity is a praiseworthy individual virtue, justice is the structural foundation of societal order and divine governance, making it more essential for the preservation of rights.
